what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from North Macedonia in Germany: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 683 asylum seekers from North Macedonia in Germany, 51.3% of all asylum seekers from North Macedonia.
Refugees from North Macedonia, a separate group, live mostly in France, Germany, Switzerland and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records one armed conflict for North Macedonia: over the government, with the UCK, in 2001.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2014 and 2015, come long after that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 113 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 13627, at the end of 2015, and was much lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Germany.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Germany only.
